text: 智力正常的成年人会有这个社会常识：只有非法产业需要保护伞，合法产业是不需要保护伞的。
en: Any mentally normal adult has this piece of common social knowledge: only illegal industries need a protective umbrella, while legal industries do not.

text: 防杠的说法是，合法产业的保护伞是代表着公权力意志的法律。
en: To pre-empt nitpicking, the protective umbrella for legal industries is the law, which represents the will of public power.

text: 这个社会常识是不言而喻的，无需解释。
en: Such common social knowledge is self-evident and needs no explanation.

text: 那些说合法化后性工作者会被黑势力控制，是没有社会常识、没有逻辑的典型表现。
en: Those who claim that after legalisation sex workers would be controlled by underworld forces are a typical example of someone lacking common social sense and logic.

text: 合法化后，如果人身自由受到威胁，可以理直气壮地报警，就如同医生遇到医闹威胁时可以果断报警一样。
en: After legalisation, if one's personal freedom is threatened, one can call the police with full justification, just as a doctor can decisively call the police when threatened by a disruptive patient or medical dispute.

text: 报警后，代表着国家意志的帽子叔叔会打击威胁你人身自由的行为。
en: After reporting it, the police, representing the will of the state, will crack down on acts that threaten your personal freedom.

text: 那些说“你支持性工作合法化，就应该支持家里女性做性工作者”的网友，同样是没有逻辑的。
en: Those netizens who say 'if you support the legalisation of sex work, you should support the women in your family becoming sex workers' are likewise lacking in logic.

text: 正常人都不希望不支持家里女性从事捡垃圾、掏大粪等行业，但是，这完全不影响这些行业是合法的。
en: Normal people do not wish, nor do they support, the women in their family taking up occupations such as scavenging or cleaning out cesspits, but this in no way affects the fact that these occupations are legal.

text: 欢迎有理有据的反驳，输出情绪的滚蛋。
en: Well-reasoned rebuttals are welcome; those who merely vent their emotions can bugger off.

text: 你问他愿不愿意自愿加班就行了。
en: Just ask him whether he is willing to work overtime 'voluntarily'.

text: 连一个小领导要求他“自愿”加班他都拒绝不了，国家都监管不了。
en: Even when a low-ranking supervisor demands that he work 'voluntarily' overtime, he cannot refuse — and the state cannot even regulate it.

text: 他凭什么认为女性可以拒绝多少沾点黑的“自愿”卖yin？
en: On what basis does he think women can refuse 'voluntary' prostitution that is more or less tainted with illegality?

text: 当然，某些人的神奇逻辑是我只负责提要求，好的结果的部分是我的功劳，坏的结果部分是执行者的问题。
en: Of course, the marvellous logic of some people goes like this: I am only responsible for setting the requirements; the good outcomes are my credit, while the bad outcomes are the executors' fault.

text: 但凡上个班都知道这种逻辑多么荒谬。
en: Anyone who has ever held a job knows how absurd this logic is.

text: 嚷嚷掏大粪、扫大街、捡破烂拿来和卖淫对比的简直脑子有问题
en: Those who go on about cleaning out cesspits, sweeping the streets and collecting scrap to compare with prostitution are simply out of their minds.

text: 这些工作不被人待见是因为又累又脏重点是没钱，这玩意儿要是月入几万你看人去不去?
en: These jobs are looked down upon because they are tiring and dirty, and crucially pay no money; if this line of work brought in tens of thousands a month, just see whether people would take it up or not?

text: 反对卖淫是因为这个吗？
en: Is opposition to prostitution because of this?

en: You support it — do you think you're a ladybird?

en: After prostitution comes selling people; surrogacy gets kicked off as well, and the whole country might as well go into the human-trafficking business.

en: All you stupid wankers think that vice is just you lot visiting prostitutes yourselves?

en: The worst of vice is human trafficking and slavery; the worst of drugs is the loss of control over medicine and chemicals — drugs are not something brainless, uneducated fellows can produce and keep iterating; the worst of gambling is organised crime, loan sharks and loss of financial control. Vice, drugs and gambling — if any one of these three is not cracked down on harshly, ordinary people will suffer even more!

text: 卖淫不合法其实好理解，因为一旦把卖淫定义为合法，那就没法在法理上把组织卖淫定义为非法行为重判了，法理上说不过去。
en: It is actually easy to understand why prostitution is illegal: once prostitution is defined as legal, it becomes impossible, in terms of jurisprudence, to define organising prostitution as an illegal act punishable by heavy sentences — it would be indefensible in law.

text: 而一旦组织卖淫合法了，那社会就乱套了，到时候就很难说清谁是自愿，谁是被迫自愿，谁是被下了套自愿的了。
en: And once organising prostitution becomes legal, society falls into chaos; then it becomes very hard to tell who is acting voluntarily, who is being forced into being 'voluntary', and who was trapped into being 'voluntary'.

text: 所以最好的办法是把卖淫定义为非法但执行上轻判，比如卖淫虽然违法但顶多也就是拘留，而真正判得重的是组织卖淫罪，最高无期。
en: So the best approach is to define prostitution as illegal but hand down lenient sentences in practice — for instance, prostitution, though unlawful, at most warrants detention, whereas what is truly sentenced heavily is the crime of organising prostitution, carrying a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.

text: 真正没法理解的是非真人表演的小说绘画等文艺作品为啥判那么重，以及机器人为啥要限制这方面功能。
en: What is truly incomprehensible is why novels, paintings and other literary and artistic works that do not involve real performers are sentenced so heavily, and why robots should have their functions in this regard restricted.

text: 这方面法律的目的应当是保护人权，而非压抑人的欲望。
en: The purpose of the law in this area should be to protect human rights, not to repress human desire.

text: 更：
en: Update:

text: 很多人拿英国香港举例，但其实恰恰证明了我的结论。
en: Many people cite Britain and Hong Kong as examples, but in fact this precisely proves my conclusion.

text: 因为英国经营卖淫场所最高只判七年，香港经营卖淫场所最高只判十年，介绍或教唆最高才六个月。
en: Because in Britain operating a prostitution venue carries a maximum sentence of only seven years, in Hong Kong operating a prostitution venue carries a maximum of only ten years, and procuring or inciting carries a maximum of just six months.

text: 注意，以上说的可是经营卖淫场所，这在我们的法律里已经算情节严重了，都是十年起步的。
en: Note that what is described above is operating a prostitution venue — under our law this already counts as a serious circumstance, and carries a starting sentence of ten years.

text: 这不就是因为个人合法，所以组织者没法重判的典型例子吗？
en: Is this not a typical example of how, because the individual act is legal, the organisers cannot be sentenced heavily?

text: 其实这个逻辑和大麻合法化是一样的。
en: In fact this logic is the same as the legalisation of cannabis.

text: 如果卖淫合法了，哪怕只是个人，那个人在社交媒体打广告算不算合法？
en: If prostitution were legalised, even if only at the individual level, would it be legal for that person to advertise on social media?

en: Would it be legal for an individual to openly solicit customers in bars, cafés or on the street?

en: Would it be legal for an individual to conduct transactions in certain venues?

en: Once the floodgates are opened, the resulting problems all have to be dealt with one by one, with jurisprudence and actual circumstances intertwined — extremely troublesome.

text: 对组织卖淫者的轻判甚至合法化，只是其中一个问题罢了。
en: Lenient sentencing or even legalisation for those who organise prostitution is merely one of these problems.

text: 虽然有些人能举例出像英国这种组织非法的地方，但欧洲组织合法的国家也多了去了，这在欧洲根本不是啥稀罕事。
en: Although some can cite places like Britain where organising is illegal, there are plenty of European countries where organising is legal; this is simply not a rarity in Europe.

en: According to reports, the gang operated large brothels illegally for years centred on North Rhine-Westphalia and across Germany as a whole, and engaged in serious tax evasion.

text: 法官汉克在宣判时表示：“他们了解德国的法律情况，属于明知故犯。
en: Judge Hanke stated when passing sentence: “They understood Germany's legal situation and acted in knowing violation of the law.

text: ”《西德汇报》报道称，团伙中的男子被判刑5年零9个月。
en: ” The West German Report stated that the man in the gang was sentenced to five years and nine months.

text: 据法官介绍，他在德国建立了一个由上百家妓院组成的“卖淫帝国”。
en: According to the judge, he built a 'prostitution empire' in Germany composed of over a hundred brothels.

text: 作为老板，他也会负责一些类似处理供电问题的琐事，公司的工商注册则部分由代理人办理。
en: As the boss, he also takes care of trivial matters such as handling power supply issues, while the company's business registration is partly handled by agents.

text: 我国人跑到德国去组建卖淫帝国，走私贩卖人口，如果我国把卖淫合法化，他们用得着去德国？
en: Our countrymen went all the way to Germany to build prostitution empires and smuggle and traffic people; if our country legalised prostitution, would they have needed to go to Germany?

text: 四、性病高发
en: IV. High Incidence of Sexually Transmitted Diseases

text: 欧洲疾病预防与控制中心的一份新的报告显示，在2010年和2017年间，欧盟确诊的梅毒病例飙升了70％。
en: A new report by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control shows that between 2010 and 2017, confirmed cases of syphilis in the EU surged by 70%.

text: 某些国家的性传播疾病激增，冰岛最终成为“领头羊”，该国的病例数量增长了876%。
en: In some countries sexually transmitted diseases have surged, with Iceland ultimately becoming the 'pacesetter', its number of cases growing by 876%.

text: 爱尔兰紧随其后，性传播疾病增长了224%，而英国和德国的梅毒发病率都增长了一倍多。
en: Ireland followed close behind, with sexually transmitted diseases rising by 224%, while the syphilis incidence rates in both Britain and Germany more than doubled.

text: 如果看了上面这些，还是认为卖淫应当合法化，想必是有了解决上述问题的良好方法了吧？
en: If, having read all the above, you still believe prostitution should be legalised, you must surely have a good method for solving the problems described above?

text: 什么？
en: What?

text: 并没有？
en: You don't?

text: 想必假如我国卖淫合法化了，如果出现了上述问题，那么肯定又是政府的错，对吧？
en: I imagine that if our country legalised prostitution and the above problems arose, then it would surely be the government's fault again, right?

text: 谁叫政府没有面面俱到呢？
en: Well, who told the government not to be thorough in every respect?
